diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default has an explicit `depends_on = ["aws_s3_bucket.origin"]`, but it already depends on that bucket implicitly: its `origin { domain_name = local.bucket_domain_name }` resolves through local.bucket_domain_name -> local.bucket, and local.bucket interpolates aws_s3_bucket.origin[*].id. Terraform tracks dependencies through locals, so ordering is already enforced and the explicit depends_on is redundant (and even a no-op when origin_bucket is supplied and the bucket has count 0).
